rules: No statistical rows are currently included.
Do not treat a source catalogue or empty template as a loaded mortality matrix.
Do not convert q_x and m_x into one another without an explicit life-table method.
This sidecar does not feed H1/H2 and does not modify canonical patterns or Engine V5.
No Google API key is required for the public UN WPP or INED catalogue routes.

sources.coverage: Period life tables, medium variant, 1950-2023; includes mx, qx, dx, Lx, ex and age-group dimensions.
sources.access: Public download; no API token required
sources.limits: Period life-table values describe a hypothetical cohort; dx/Lx are not observed deaths and population exposure.

sources.dataset: Life tables for France and départements, 1806-1906
sources.coverage: Quinquennial periods 1806-1810 through 1901-1905; q(x) by five-year age group and département, with France total.
sources.access: Public page; download endpoint redirects to INED
sources.limits: Do not redistribute or ingest the raw file until reuse terms are clarified. q(x) is a period probability, not m(x).

sources.coverage: Estimated annual deaths by age and sex; national 1950-2070 and state-level 1970-2070 per dataset description.
sources.license: Verify on resource metadata before redistribution
sources.limits: Separate estimates and projections; verify exposure denominator before calculating rates.

sources.coverage: Country life-table indicators; verify metadata and status of each series.

sources.dataset: Historical and period life tables by country
sources.coverage: Country-specific historical and period tables; availability varies by country and period.
Varies by country; access conditions may apply.
